40021758.author: पदार्थः
40021758.content: अथ then, नावं boat, सुविस्तीर्णां very spacious, नैषादीं belonging to the Nishadas, राघवानुजः Rama's younger brother, आरुरोह boarded, समायुक्तां well-equipped, पूर्वं first, आरोप्य having placed, मैथिलीम् Maithili.

40021758.author: Translation
40021758.content: Then, Rama's younger brother, Lakshmana, first having placed Maithili (Sita) on the very spacious and well-equipped boat belonging to the Nishadas, himself boarded it.

40021759.author: पदार्थः
40021759.content: सुमन्त्रं Sumantra, चैव and, सरथं with the chariot, स्थीयतामिति "stay here" thus, लक्ष्मणः Lakshmana, उवाच said, शोकसन्तप्तः distressed by sorrow, प्रयाहीति "proceed" thus, च and, नाविकम् to the boatman.

40021759.author: Translation
40021759.content: Distressed by sorrow, Lakshmana told Sumantra to stay there with the chariot and instructed the boatman to proceed.

40021760.author: पदार्थः
40021760.content: ततः then, तीरम् the bank, उपागम्य having approached, भागीरथ्याः of the Bhagirathi (Ganga), सः that, लक्ष्मणः Lakshmana, उवाच spoke, मैथिलीं to Maithili (Sita), वाक्यं words, प्राञ्जलिः with folded hands, बाष्पसम्प्लुतः bathed in tears.

40021760.author: Translation
40021760.content: Then, having reached the bank of the Bhagirathi, Lakshmana, with folded hands and bathed in tears, spoke to Sita.

40021761.author: पदार्थः
40021761.content: हृद्गतं residing in the heart, मे my, महच्छल्यं great dart/thorn, यस्मात् because of which, आर्येण by the noble one (Rama), धीमता by the wise one, अस्मिन् in this, निमित्ते matter/cause, वैदेहि O Vaidehi (Sita), लोकस्य of the people, वचनीकृतः made an object of reproach.

40021761.author: Translation
40021761.content: O Vaidehi, a great thorn resides in my heart because of which the wise and noble Rama has been made an object of public reproach in this matter.

40021762.author: पदार्थः
40021762.content: श्रेयः better, हि indeed, मरणं death, मे for me, अद्य today, मृत्युर्वा or death, यत् which, परं ultimate, भवेत् may be, न not, च and, अस्मिन् in this, ईदृशे such, कार्ये task/deed, नियोज्यः to be employed, लोकनिन्दिते censured by people.

40021762.author: Translation
40021762.content: Indeed, death or whatever ultimate demise may befall me today would be better, for I should not be employed in such a task that is censured by the people.

40021763.author: पदार्थः
40021763.content: प्रसीद be gracious, च and, न not, मे to me, पापं sin, कर्तुम् to do, अर्हसि you ought, शोभने O beautiful one, इति thus, अञ्जलिकृतः having folded hands, भूमौ on the ground, निपपात fell down, सः that, लक्ष्मणः Lakshmana.

40021763.author: Translation
40021763.content: "Be gracious, O beautiful one, and do not commit this sin against me," thus saying, Lakshmana, with folded hands, fell to the ground.

40021764.author: पदार्थः
40021764.content: रुदन्तं crying, प्राञ्जलिं with folded hands, दृष्ट्वा having seen, काङ्क्षन्तं desiring, मृत्युम् death, आत्मनः for himself, मैथिली Maithili (Sita), भृशसंविग्ना greatly agitated, लक्ष्मणं to Lakshmana, वाक्यम् words, अब्रवीत् spoke.

40021764.author: Translation
40021764.content: Seeing Lakshmana crying, with folded hands, and desiring his own death, Sita became greatly agitated and spoke to him.

40021765.author: पदार्थः
40021765.content: किम् what, इदम् this, न not, अवगच्छामि I understand, ब्रूहि tell, तत्त्वेन truly, लक्ष्मण O Lakshmana, पश्यामि I see, त्वां you, न not, च and, स्वस्थम् well, अपि is it, क्षेमम् well-being, महीपतेः of the king.

40021765.author: Translation
40021765.content: O Lakshmana, I do not understand what this is; tell me the truth, for I see you are not well, and I wonder if the king is safe.

40021766.author: पदार्थः
40021766.content: शापितः असि you have been cursed, नरेन्द्रेण by the king, यत् that, त्वम् you, सन्तापम् sorrow, आगतः have reached, तत् that, ब्रूयाः you should tell, सन्निधौ in the presence, मह्यम् to me, अहम् I, आज्ञापयामि command, ते you.

40021766.author: Translation
40021766.content: You must tell me in my presence if you have been cursed by the king, which has caused you such distress, for I command you to do so.

40021767.author: पदार्थः
40021767.content: वैदेह्या by Vaidehi, चोद्यमानः being urged, तु but, लक्ष्मणः Lakshmana, दीनचेतनः with a sorrowful mind, अवाङ्मुखः with downcast face, बाष्पकलम् with choked voice, वाक्यम् words, एतत् these, उवाच ह spoke.

40021767.author: Translation
40021767.content: Being urged by Sita, Lakshmana, with a sorrowful mind and downcast face, spoke these words in a voice choked with tears.

40021768.author: पदार्थः
40021768.content: श्रुत्वा having heard, परिषदः of the assembly, मध्ये in the midst, हि indeed, अपवादम् slander, सुदारुणम् very harsh, पुरे in the city, जनपदे in the countryside, च and, एव indeed, त्वत्कृते because of you, जनकात्मजे O daughter of Janaka, रामः Rama, सन्तप्तहृदयः with a tormented heart, मा me, निवेद्य having informed, गृहम् home, गतः went.

40021768.author: Translation
40021768.content: O daughter of Janaka, having heard a very harsh slander against you in the assembly, both in the city and the countryside, Rama, with a tormented heart, informed me and then went home.

40021769.author: पदार्थः
40021769.content: न not, तानि those, वचनीयानि to be spoken, मया by me, देवि O Goddess, तवाग्रतः in front of you, यानि which, राज्ञा by the king, हृदि in the heart, न्यस्तानि placed, अमर्षात् due to public opinion, पृष्ठतः aside, कृतः made.

40021769.author: Translation
40021769.content: Lakshmana tells Sita that he cannot speak to her the words that King Rama has kept in his heart but has set aside due to public opinion.

40021770.author: पदार्थः
40021770.content: सा such, त्वं you, त्यक्ता abandoned, नृपतिना by the king, निर्दोषा faultless, मम my, सन्निधौ in the presence, पौरापवादभीतेन by one who fears the scandal of the citizens, ग्राह्यं to be accepted, देवि O Goddess, न not, ते by you, अन्यथा otherwise.

40021770.author: Translation
40021770.content: Lakshmana informs Sita that she, though faultless in his presence, has been abandoned by the king who fears public scandal, and this command must be accepted by her without question.

40021771.author: पदार्थः
40021771.content: आश्रमान्तेषु at the borders of the hermitages, च and, मया by me, त्यक्तव्या to be abandoned, त्वं you, भविष्यसि will be, राज्ञः of the king, शासनम् command, आज्ञाय having known, तव your, इदं this, किल indeed, दौर्हृदम् longing.

40021771.author: Translation
40021771.content: Lakshmana further explains that he will abandon her at the borders of the hermitages, understanding that this is the king's command and also related to her longing for the forest.

40021772.author: पदार्थः
40021772.content: तत् that, एतत् this, जाह्नवीतीरे on the bank of the Ganga, ब्रह्मर्षीणां of the Brahmarishis, तपोवनम् hermitage, पुण्यं sacred, च and, रमणीयं delightful, च and, मा do not, विषादं sorrow, कृथाः do, शुभे O auspicious one.

40021772.author: Translation
40021772.content: Lakshmana points out that this hermitage on the bank of the Ganga is sacred and delightful, belonging to Brahmarishis, and urges Sita, the auspicious one, not to despair.

40021773.author: पदार्थः
40021773.content: राज्ञः of the king, दशरथस्य Dasharatha, इष्टः dear, पितुः of the father, मे my, मुनिपुङ्गवः chief among sages, सखा friend, परमकः supreme, विप्रः Brahmin, वाल्मीकिः Valmiki, सुमहायशाः very famous.

40021773.author: Translation
40021773.content: Lakshmana informs Sita that the highly renowned sage Valmiki, who is a dear and supreme friend to his father King Dasharatha, resides here.

40021774.author: पदार्थः
40021774.content: पादच्छायाम् in the shade of the feet, उपागम्य having approached, सुखम् happily, अस्य of this, महात्मनः great soul, उपवासपरैकाग्रा intent on fasting and concentrated, वस dwell, त्वम् you, जनकात्मजे O daughter of Janaka.

40021774.author: Translation
40021774.content: O daughter of Janaka, you should dwell happily and with focused devotion to fasting in the shade of this great soul (Valmiki).

40021775.author: पदार्थः
40021775.content: पतिव्रतात्वम् the state of being a devoted wife, आस्थाय having adopted, रामम् Rama, कृत्वा having placed, सदा always, हृदि in the heart, श्रेयः ultimate good, ते your, परमम् supreme, देवि O goddess, तथा thus, कृत्वा having done, भविष्यति will be.

40021775.author: Translation
40021775.content: O goddess, by adopting the state of a devoted wife and always keeping Rama in your heart, your supreme welfare will be achieved. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे सप्तचत्वारिंशः सर्गः ।। 47 ।। Thus ends the forty-seventh sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
